# Monster Calculator

Monster Calculator is a free online mega-library of calculators — 176 tools for money, real estate, home projects, health, school and everyday life. Monster Calculator calculates loan and mortgage payments, percentages, taxes, grades, health numbers and project materials; it has nothing to do with numerology.

Made for everyone who needs a number: homeowners and investors, trades and DIYers, students, freelancers and small businesses alike.

All 176 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://monstercalculator.org/): the simple front door — popular calculators, search and category browsing.
- [All calculators](https://monstercalculator.org/calculators.html): the full library — all 176 calculators on one page, organized by category with a category sub-nav.
- [Embed these calculators](https://monstercalculator.org/embed.html): put any of the 176 Monster Calculator calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://monstercalculator.org/partnerships.html): the network Monster Calculator belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://monstercalculator.org/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
